title: Zelda's Lullaby
note: A slow waltz that floats on the four chord instead of resting on G. Keep the third finger on the low C through the first two shapes and move only the top fingers. Pick each chord one string at a time, bass note first, and let it ring. The tune itself is left out.
remarks: One usable chord source: Hooktheory (G major, three-four, 106; A is IVmaj7 to V7 over the same bass, B is Fmaj7 Em7 Dm7 Cmaj7 Fmaj7; 72 beats, so 24 bars). Its tags hint at more chords in A and a tritone substitute ending B that could not be read; B bars 6 to 8 are my guess. A UG ukulele sheet opens I to minor iv.
